verdict.rationale: PayPal's own accept-payments page says merchants can swiftly create a Payment Link to share on a website, by email, on social media, or by text, with no coding skills required. That directly covers the shareable no-code link. Invoicing adds a related shareable secure URL or QR payment page that needs no custom payment flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the link is created in the business dashboard, detail on setup steps and how fast a new seller can go live, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Swiftly create a Payment Link to share on your website, via email, on social media, or through text. No coding skills required.
get paid through a secure PayPal payment page, without building their own payment flow
